# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V3001 effect_not_allowed"
description: "The body performs an effect that the function's signature does not allow."
---

An error from the `effect` phase. `sakura explain V3001` prints this explanation offline.

The body performs an effect that the function's signature does not allow. A signature's effect
row is an upper bound (design §5.7); omitting `!` means `! {}`.

The `cause` span points at the call that introduced the effect. Two repairs:
- add the effect to the signature (`interface_change`: every caller must allow it too), or
- handle it locally with `with handler { … }` (`local`).

Wrong:

```sakura
fn greet(name: String) -> Unit { Console.print("hello, {name}") }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn greet(name: String) -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hello, {name}") }
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V3001_greet_without_console.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V3001_greet_without_console.sakura), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn greet(name: String) -> Unit { Console.print("hello, {name}") }

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { greet("Sakura Lang") }
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V3001_greet_without_console.fixed.sakura`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/V3001_greet_without_console.fixed.sakura), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:

```sakura
fn greet(name: String) -> Unit ! {Console} { Console.print("hello, {name}") }

pub fn main() -> Unit ! {Console} { greet("Sakura Lang") }
```
